name: World Trivia 2018
author: Addicting Games
description: World Trivia 2018 is a quiz game based on trivia from around the world. Select your country of choice, and answer trivia questions from that region. Use the image depicted along with the available letters to spell out the topic of the picture. Click on the letters to add them to the screen, and click on them again if you need to remove them. Complete each level with sufficient time to earn enough stars and unlock the next level. You can use stars to unlock hints to help you out with more difficult subjects. There are 28 levels for you to unlock and solve! The faster you answer, the better your score. If you run out of time, you lose that level and have to start over. Submit your score to see if you are one of the best trivia players on AddictingGames.com!
